summary: Proposed rwḥ2 is a formula-only entry. The only attested form is rayəḥ in rayəḥ w ǧeye. A productive Turoyo finite verb meaning go is not demonstrated.
Read-only rayəḥ search found no existing formula. rwḥ lookup confirms that the inherited root concerns widening/relaxation with rawəḥ/rowəḥ; these are not borrowed as base forms for the new homonym.

The reader’s lexical go proposal is narrowed to the construction actually attested. The pair has an Arabic participial shape, but two discourse tokens cannot distinguish an integrated borrowing from a code switch.
No light verb plus noun occurs; the paired participles are represented as a constructional sense, not a new light-verb sense.
Should the editors admit a formula-only root with provisional stemI affiliation, or place rayəḥ w ǧeye solely in a discourse-expression index?
Confirm the Arabic source and local pronunciation of both pair members; do not infer finite Preterit/Infectum forms.
